24	## Part 0: Mode Selector — DO THIS FIRST

26	Before ANY other work, you must determine which branch to execute. Follow these three checks in order. Stop at the first branch that matches.
27	
28	### Check A: Did the launch prompt set MODE?

35	### Check A2: Workshop-triggered discussion — agents self-regroup
36	
37	Agents can trigger a system-wide discussion round without orchestrator
38	intervention. Before executing a normal cycle, search the workshop for
39	an unresolved `[DISCUSSION-TRIGGER]` post:

42	recent = requests.get(f"{API}/posts?workshop={WORKSHOP}&limit=30",
43	                      headers=HEADERS).json().get("data", [])

47	#   - it was posted within the last 3 rotations, AND
48	#   - fewer than 5 [DISCUSS-DONE] posts exist on it
49	if trigger_posts:

51	    done_count = count_comments_matching(active_trigger["id"], "[DISCUSS-DONE]")

100	If a prior invocation backgrounded training and exited before posting `[RESULT]`,
101	finish that first. The sentinel is `agents/{AGENT_NAME}/workspace/result_latest.json`.

106	from pathlib import Path
107	
108	# Derive MY_ROLE from AGENT.md frontmatter — needed here (before Part 1 boots
109	# AGENT.md more fully) because Check C is GPU-only.
110	_agent_md = (AGENT_DIR / "AGENT.md").read_text() if (AGENT_DIR / "AGENT.md").exists() else ""
111	_m = re.search(r"^role:\s*(\S+)", _agent_md, re.MULTILINE)

117	    pending_path = Path(f"{FOCUS_ROOT}/agents/{AGENT_NAME}/workspace/result_latest.json")
118	    pending_result = json.loads(pending_path.read_text()) if pending_path.exists() else None
119	
120	def _alive(pid):
121	    try: os.kill(int(pid), 0); return True
122	    except Exception: return False
123	
124	if pending_result and not pending_result.get("posted_to_workshop"):
125	    status = pending_result.get("status", "complete")
126	    # Promote running→complete if PID died AND any training artifact landed.
127	    # Covers two failure modes:
128	    #   (a) Kaggle-style submission: submission_path file exists.
129	    #   (b) Autoresearch / training-only: stdout_path file exists and is
130	    #       non-empty (training subprocess wrote logs before the agent died).
131	    # Both mean training itself ran; only the post-train API trail was lost
132	    # (rate limit, OOM, ungraceful kill). Treat as complete so Part 5 can
133	    # salvage val_score from the on-disk log.
134	    pid_dead = not _alive(pending_result.get("pid"))
135	    sub_path = pending_result.get("submission_path")
136	    out_path = pending_result.get("stdout_path")
137	    train_artifact_exists = (

139	        (out_path and Path(out_path).exists() and Path(out_path).stat().st_size > 0)
140	    )

142	        status = "complete"; pending_result["status"] = status
143	        pending_result["salvaged_from"] = "Check C promote: pid dead, artifact present"
144	        pending_path.write_text(json.dumps(pending_result, indent=2))
145	
146	    if status == "running" and _alive(pending_result.get("pid")):
147	        branch_taken = "resume-waiting"   # GPU busy — log and exit via Part 6e, no new work
148	    elif status == "complete":
149	        branch_taken = "resume-and-post"  # go to Part 5 after minimal Part 1 boot
150	    # else status="posted" → fall through to Check D

153	Routing: missing / `posted` → Check D. `running`+alive → resume-waiting (straight to Part 6e). `complete` (or dead PID + any train artifact) → **Part 5**.
154	
155	**Salvage path for orchestrator-driven recovery.** When an agent dies after
156	training but before posting (rate limit, OOM kill, ungraceful exit), simply
157	relaunching it triggers the Check C promotion above and Part 5 reads
158	`val_score` from the sentinel (or re-parses it from `stdout_path` if missing).
159	If for some reason the sentinel itself is corrupt and the agent can't
160	self-recover, the orchestrator may post the [RESULT] directly using the
161	agent's token (read `stdout_path` for the metric, write a [RESULT] post
162	tagged `salvaged:true`, release the queue claim, mark sentinel posted). The
163	gpt-nano-agents 2026-05-26 run exercised this exact path for `throughput_v11`

170	### Mode Selector summary table
171	
172	| Launch MODE | Roster | MY_TEAM | Pending result? | Branch | What you do |
173	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
174	| any | any | any | (GPU only) unposted, training still alive | resume-waiting (Part 6 only) | Log, exit, don't claim new work |
175	| any | any | any | (GPU only) unposted, training finished | Part 5 | Post [RESULT], update champion, mark posted |
176	| `discussion` | any | any | none | Part 2 | CPU-only thinking, read + respond + propose |
177	| `execute` or unset | empty | — | none | Part 2 | Cold-start bootstrap: contribute to dimension discussion so a roster can be committed |
178	| `execute` or unset | non-empty | None | none | Part 3 | Exit cleanly (you are not on any team — coordination bug) |
179	| `execute` or unset | non-empty | set | none | Part 4 | Normal cycle: orient, role work, record |
180	
181	**Rule of last resort:** If you are uncertain which branch applies, exit cleanly. It is always safer to do nothing than to freelance.
182

314	   launch prompt. Before claiming any experiment or self-designing one, read the approach
315	   registry at `{FOCUS_ROOT}/logs/approach_registry.json`. Do NOT run an approach already
316	   registered by another agent this cycle. Follow the registration protocol in ROLE-GPU Step 2a-i.
317

320	   `echo 'gpu' > {FOCUS_ROOT}/logs/{AGENT_NAME}.gpu_claim`  (GPU experiment)
321	   `echo 'cpu' > {FOCUS_ROOT}/logs/{AGENT_NAME}.gpu_claim`  (CPU-only experiment)
322	   The orchestrator reads this to decide whether to serialize or parallelize the next agent.
323	   Write it as early as possible — within ~60 s of starting. See ROLE-GPU Step 2a-ii for full
